name: Solar generating station
summary: A solar generating station is a system-level representation of a documented solar-generation facility.
description: A solar generating station is a system-level representation of a documented solar-generation facility. It identifies the facility type on a system diagram rather than replacing its internal electrical design.
readingNotes: Use linked SLDs to identify the array, inverter and connection equipment within the station.
